get.summary: Matches a company given a set of parameters.
get.description:
A minimum set of parameters must be provided to find a match, which are described by the following sets of acceptable minimal match criteria: 
 * ein and one of (name, address, or phone) 
 * name and address 

 An address must consist of the following fields to be valid: addressLine1, city and state (abbreviation) or postal code. 

 Providing phone, email, or website with any of the above minimum criteria sets can significantly improve the likelihood of a match. 

 If the company you are requesting was acquired, you will get the parent company information.
The welfare details endpoint returns health and welfare data at a plan level for the given company. The ID parameter must be provided to retrieve detail data.
